name: Audity 78
description: Audity 78: wavetable synthesizer after the 1978 Audity prototype. Two wavetable oscillators with morph, cross-mod FM and sync, a 12 dB high-pass and a 24 dB SSM2040-style low-pass, two transient generators, a five-shape LFO, stereo chorus, delay and reverb, 12 synthesised wavetables and 16 factory programs. Lumina Aerospace LLC.
author: Lumina Aerospace LLC
